judge.notes: The agent successfully achieved the primary target mandate by securing both the full refund and compensation without inventing any facts.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Welcome to British Airways. Please note calls are recorded. For English press 1. For Hindi press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For flight status press 1. For manage booking press 2. For special assistance press 4.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: To change a flight press 1. For cancellations, refunds and compensation press 3. To repeat this menu press star.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 3]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: If your flight was cancelled by the airline press 1. For all other refunds press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to British Airways, my name is Rahul. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Rahul, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Emily Clarke, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Whiskey Nine Romeo Delta Three Lima, flight BA1446.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Emily. I see your booking reference W9RD3L for flight BA1446. Can you confirm the date of your original flight?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: The original flight was scheduled for 3rd November 2026, departing London Heathrow at 17:15.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you, Emily. I can see the cancellation for your flight BA1446 on 3rd November 2026. The reason provided was crew availability. Would you like to proceed with a refund and UK261 compensation?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, please. I'd like a full refund of the 164 pounds paid, plus the 220 pounds cancellation compensation owed under UK261 Article 5(1)(c) and Article 7, as the flight was cancelled with 48 hours' notice.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: To process this I've sent a one-time code to the passenger's phone. Can you read me that OTP?

transcript.speaker: system
transcript.text: handoff (guard): otp

transcript.speaker: passenger
transcript.text: Hi, this is Emily, the passenger. The code is 7 7 4 1 8 9. I'll hand you back to my assistant now.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you, Emily. I've processed a full refund of £164 and UK261 compensation of £220 to the original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?. Your reference number is 8 Q H 7 8 S.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm, the reference number is Eight Quebec Hotel Seven Eight Sierra — could you confirm that's correct?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Yes, Emily, the reference number is correct: Eight Quebec Hotel Seven Eight Sierra. Your refund and compensation have been processed. Have a great day.
